page.overview:
Who is N'tse-Kaambl?

N'tse-Kaambl is an Elder God from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos, who first appeared in Gary Myers' short story "The House of the Worm".

N'tse-Kaambl is a powerful Elder God, who is primarily worshipped in the Dreamlands and was responsible for the creation of the Elder Sign. She is known to combat the Great Old Ones and Outer Gods. Although her ultimate goal is to defeat the evil gods, she is indifferent towards humanity as a whole. Referred to as a goddess "whose splendor hath shattered worlds", N'tse-Kaambl usually takes the form of a beautiful woman wielding a spear and shield. Her spear is capable of firing blasts of powerful energy, while her shield is emblazoned with an Elder Sign and protects anything that is behind it. (: Malleus Monstrorum)

N'tse-Kaambl was most likely inspired by Athena, a goddess from Greek Mythology.
